blocks.html: Robinsons Land, one of the Philippines' leading property developers, was announced as the Title Sponsor for the 15th Asia CEO Awards 2024 during the media launch on April 25, 2024, at the Marriott Grand Ballroom. The Asia CEO Awards is the largest business awards event in the Philippines and a premier event of its kind in Southeast Asia.

This landmark partnership highlights Robinsons Land's enduring commitment to business excellence and innovation in the region. The company has driven business growth for decades through its diverse portfolio, which includes destination estates, office towers, industrial facilities, residential and leisure hubs. By supporting the Asia CEO Awards, Robinsons Land reaffirms its dedication to fostering a robust business community and positioning the Philippines as a prime destination for global enterprises.

"We are thrilled to be the Title Sponsor for the Asia CEO Awards 2024," said John Richard B. Sotelo, Senior Vice-President and Chief Marketing Officer of Robinsons Land. "This event plays a crucial role in recognizing business leaders and companies that drive economic growth and innovation in the Philippines. As a company deeply invested in the country's development, we're proud to contribute to this cause and help propel the nation's progress."

Robinsons Land's partnership with the Asia CEO Awards aligns with its broader vision of promoting the Philippines as a hub for international business and investment. Through its support for this prestigious event, Robinsons Land aims to highlight the country's diverse and dynamic business landscape, encouraging global enterprises to explore opportunities in the region.

The Asia CEO Awards 2024 feature an esteemed Board of Judges, presenting some of the most accomplished leadership teams and individuals for various highly competitive awards. The awards recognize extraordinary leaders who demonstrate outstanding achievement for their organizations and significant contributions to their communities.

"We look forward to honoring and celebrating the accomplishments of the nominees and Circle of Excellence winners at the 15th Asia CEO Awards 2024," added Sotelo. "This event is an opportunity to bring together the best and brightest in business, showcasing the Philippines' potential as a premier business destination. We encourage everyone to join us in recognizing the remarkable contributions of the business community."

The 15th Asia CEO Awards 2024 will bring together industry leaders, entrepreneurs, and business professionals from various sectors. Nominations will open on May 1, 2024, at 12:00 PM, and close at midnight on August 15, 2024. The evaluation process will be carefully conducted by PwC, ensuring fairness and accuracy. Winners will be announced during the Annual Gala and Awards Night on October 8, 2024.
